chunks: 24 – Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, Abu Ja'far. Trustworthy, trustworthy.

key_terms.ثقة: Trustworthy/Reliable (a technical term in hadith sciences indicating a narrator's reliability)

ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical assessment of the narrator Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, known as Abu Ja'far. He is described as 'thiqa' (trustworthy/reliable), a designation used in Shia hadith sciences to indicate a narrator's reliability in transmitting traditions.
